# Pre-v2 segment store fixture

`root/` is a segment store root exactly as WeftDB wrote it before store layout 2
(crash-consistency design, slice S6), at commit `bcf0304` (`durability/base`). It is
the "checked-in pre-v2 store" of the design's compatibility fixtures (section 11):

- `segment_index.db` records every frame by an absolute path into
  `/var/tmp/weft-pre-v2-fixture/root/segments/`, the root it was written in, which no
  longer exists. A reader finds the frames only by resolving those paths against the
  root it opened.
- Frames are named `{aspect}-{id}.weftseg` (generation 0), each with a v3 `.weftpart`
  sidecar.
- The four control-plane databases are in MVCC mode, with their committed rows still in
  the `-log` files (no checkpoint ran before the store closed). `LOCK` and
  `LOCK.holder` were left out.

It holds the aspects `price` (a dense, a nullable, a paged and an out-of-order segment,
the last overlapping the first) and `temp` (one dense segment), as sealed by
`seal_legacy_layout` in `weftdb/src/types/segment_store.rs`.

`expected_reads.txt` is what `fixture_reads` (same file) returned on that build, with
the store still in its original root. The test
`a_pre_v2_store_migrates_idempotently_and_reads_identically` copies `root/` to a
temporary directory, opens it three times, and requires every open to read exactly
this, with the migration rewriting no frame and leaving the same schema each time.

The fixture cannot be regenerated by a current build: any build from S6 on writes
layout 2. Keep these files as they are.
